notes.title: 3rd Anniversary of the Official Release
notes.notes:
(I'm not good at english)
July 20 is the 3rd anniversary of Attack of the Gigant Zombie vs Unity chan, since its official release
In commemoration of that, I will show you a recipe for an item you can make with the pot, which perhaps no one has found

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32131495/8434af849bf93cf5d80b6d8067220feefda69f6b.jpg[/img]

Put these three ingredients in the pot, and you will get a special item (there is no achievement regarding this, it is only to decorate the house)
It is necessary to have the pot in the house, it can be found in the destroyed city


This will be the last news of AotGZvsU (or maybe not)
Someday I want to make a more decent game of this style
If you like, please also check out other games from Rusimitu Games

Sadly, most people only bought this game to mock or laugh for a moment, with no intention of playing...but that depends on each person
And finally, many thanks to everyone who played this game to the end, who wrote decent review, who uploaded awesome screenshots, who shared good videos, and who wrote the guide
I apologize for having made you suffer for the bad operability. Thank you very much to all
